facts.fact: 在酒馆旁，Gabriel 兴冲冲带 Rory 看老脾气 daemonite 铁匠 Johneck 淬火制剑；Johneck 只闷声应了句「殿下」、几乎不看人，Gabriel 却看得津津有味，还说桌上金饰是买来熔了做剑柄嵌金用的。
facts.anchor: Johneck, an old gruff daemonite, was quenching a blade that sizzled in cold water, steam rising around him.

facts.fact: 炉火边 Rory 在待熔金饰里发现一枚厚金戒指，顶上刻着「角间衔叶的雄鹿」——正是她家族的纹章、她父亲的戒指；她一把抓起冲到 Johneck 面前高声追问来源，Gabriel 的笑容消失。
facts.anchor: The ring was heavy and had a crest on the top of it of a stag with a leaf between its horns.

facts.fact: Johneck 称金饰都是二手收来、不记得卖戒者姓名，只知对方说急需钱还赌债；Rory 呼吸急促、膝盖发软，四周声响变得又吵又失真。
facts.anchor: “My lady, I buy jewelry second-hand. I don’t recall the name of who sold it to me, but he said he acquired it and needed money to settle his gambling debt,” Johneck shrugged.

facts.fact: Rory 喊出实情：父亲的戒指出现在 Tironaill，而父亲是多年来失踪人数不断攀升中的一员——人类正被带进 Tironaill；Gabriel 斥为不可能、说无法想象人类会被带来，又称她反应「有点歇斯底里」，但答应派士兵调查、审问手中的俘虏，并付双倍价买下这枚戒指交给她。
facts.anchor: This was my father’s ring, and now it is in Tironaill! My father was one of the many people who have disappeared in increasing numbers over the years. Humans are being brought into Tironaill!

facts.fact: 爆炸骤起，Rory 被气浪掀翻在地、后脑磕上鹅卵石路面出血；Gabriel 判断是民兵炸了酒馆，把她安置在街车车轮边就去帮忙搜救幸存者，国王卫队随后冲向废墟——那枚戒指已飞脱，Rory 忍痛爬回铁匠摊寻找。
facts.anchor: A deafening boom shuddered around us, and I was thrown backwards onto the ground in an instant. My ears rang after my vision cleared, my head throbbing from smacking into the cobblestone street.

facts.fact: Rosalyn 赶到，用发白光的掌心为 Rory 止血止痛；听说是 Gabriel 留下伤者去「当英雄」后出言讥讽。Rory 求她找那枚雄鹿纹章金戒并保密，Ros 爽快应下「戒指、保密」。
facts.anchor: “Rory!” I looked up to see Rosalyn racing toward me. “Oh, my word, are you alright?” She helped me stand and paused at the blood running down my neck. Her hand covered the back of my head, and a white light emitted from it, easing the pain down to a dull throb, stopping the bleeding.

facts.fact: Darragh 骑 Astorath 赶到，说 Gabriel 只命令他把 Rory 送回城堡、没提她受了伤；Ros 讽刺 Gabriel 怕被抢功才支开他。Darragh 把 Rory 扶上马背，途中拐进上次图书馆之行后带她去的那片树林。
facts.anchor: Gabriel told me you were over here and ordered me to take you back to the castle. He didn’t tell me you were injured,” he growled out.

facts.fact: 树林里 Rory 说父亲失踪到今年春天整十一年，她不敢相信他一直在 Tironaill；她祈祷 Clotha 保佑 Ros 找回戒指，并拒绝给 Themis 献血赎罪——说今天在市场已流了够多血，Themis 想要就得去街上刮。
facts.anchor: I hope so, and in the meantime, I pray to Clotha that Ros can find my father’s ring. I can’t believe he has been here this whole time.

facts.fact: Darragh 确认人类正从 Edenalee 被拐运进 Tironaill，说会与 Gabriel 商量组一队人去西谷搜查异常，并建议民兵攻势升级期间 Rory 尽量留在城堡；Rory 想讲自己在 Gabriel 书房看到的那本「书」，却因失血眼前发黑晕过去，被 Darragh 紧急送回城堡——她想，若要晕倒，晕在 Tironaill 最危险的 seraph 身边最安全。
facts.anchor: I will speak with Gabriel about it and see if I can devise a team to go search the west valley for anything strange.
